params.body:
Pins Standard `v0.17.0` (gentells-standard #22): the competitor list Gentells never names, cites or links.

- `bin/sync-standard.mjs` → `v0.17.0`; `standard.mjs`, `standard-types.d.ts` and the conformance fixture regenerated by it.
- `packages/core/competitors.mjs` reads `STANDARD.rules.competitors` and drops the copy it carried since #381, so a company added in a release of the Standard reaches the checks and the prompts with the next pin.
- `test/competitors.test.mjs` checks the matcher against the Standard's own conformance cases from the fixture (20 text, 10 link) instead of a copy.

No behaviour changes: the list is the one #381 carried.

Tests: full suite 1348 of 1354, the 6 `report-render` failures need pdftoppm and fail on main too. `tsc` clean.
